items.title: Well Travelled :: Talk Talk’s Final Live Performances 40 Years On
items.summary: With In Another World: The Four Seasons of Talk Talk , music writer Graeme Thomson charts one of the most mystical trajectories ever undertaken by a one-time pop band. Today marks the 40th anniversary of the band's final live performance in Spain. To commemorate, we're pleased to share an edited extract from In Another World. items.title: Elkie Brooks looks back: ‘Before I went on stage I used to drink Guinness and a few shots of brandy’
items.summary: The singer-songwriter on her rock’n’roll past, playing second fiddle to the Beatles, and the key to being an energetic performer in your 80s Born Elaine Bookbinder in Salford in 1945, Elkie Brooks is a rock, blues and jazz singer known as the British Queen of Blues. She spent much of the 1960s on the cabaret circuit, during which time she supported the Beatles. She joined Dada in 1970, before forming Vinegar Joe with Robert Palmer in 1971.
